Specification: This module is a small illustrative TLA+ specification whose main purpose is to demonstrate different TLA+ comment styles rather than to model a substantive distributed algorithm or protocol. It defines four simple top-level operators, each equal to TRUE, alongside comments showing boxed comments, indented boxed comments, free-form multi-line comments, line comments beginning with \\*, inline comments, and horizontal divider lines. The module also declares two variables x and y, but it does not define an initial condition, next-state relation, temporal specification, fairness condition, or proof obligations.
